1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Collect failed test results of electrical appliances and categorise them according to the electrical underground cable leakage current test, circuit bypass test, circuit grounding (G) and neutral (N) test, circuit polarisation test, and portable appliance grounding (G) and neutral (N) test results.
3. Document the test results, based on the test records, as follows:
    i. Electrical underground cable leakage current test
        - Device type: Electrician
        - Serial number: GB/T3836.15-2017
        - Expected results: Pass
        - Actual results: Fail
        - Failure analysis: Leakage current exceeds standard requirements
        - Failure reasons: Cable shielding layer is damaged.
        - Evidence: Test records (Appendix 1)
    ii. Circuit bypass test
        - Device type: electrician
        - Serial number: GB/T3836.15
